svg.aria-label: Identity and security view of the webshop: the web apps, container apps and API Management run as one user-assigned identity and the order processor as another; each identity holds the data-plane roles it needs on Key Vault, storage, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, the registry, AI Search and OpenAI, an Entra group administers SQL and Key Vault, and key-based access is disabled on the data services.
svg.title: Webshop identity and security view
svg.text: data-plane access by Azure RBAC only
Queue Data Contributor, Blob Data Owner (host)
The payment provider key exists only in Key Vault: the Catalog API reads it through a Key Vault reference and API Management through a
Key Vault named value, both as id-webshop-apps. SQL uses Entra-only authentication; storage, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, OpenAI and the registry have
their key-based access switched off; TLS 1.2 is the minimum everywhere; the data services accept connections only through private endpoints.
